description: This source file defines the ContentTypesAdminNodeNavigationBuilder class, which implements navigation building logic for content type admin nodes within OrchardCore, including methods for building navigation menus, filtering content types based on permissions, and generating icon classes.

classes.name: ContentTypesAdminNodeNavigationBuilder
classes.description: Implements navigation building for content type admin nodes, handling menu construction, permission checks, and icon class generation.

methods.name: BuildNavigationAsync
methods.description: Builds the navigation menu for content types, adding entries for each listable content type and handling child nodes.

methods.name: GetListableContentTypeDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and filters content type definitions based on visibility and permissions.

methods.name: GetIconClasses
methods.description: Generates CSS classes for icons based on content type and node settings.

methods.name: AddPrefixToClasses
methods.description: Adds a CSS class prefix to a list of icon classes.
